delivery.format: one NAME=VALUE assignment per requested input; do not place values in chat, git, CI logs, or evidence files

expected_evidence.staging: TLS certificate/headers, external health and source identity, persistent-volume restart, prior-digest rollback and candidate forward-recovery receipts, plus a raw-sample-derived 24-hour soak on one uninterrupted immutable candidate container
expected_evidence.backup: fresh schema-v2 encrypted-backup manifest bound to the exact offsite URI and ciphertext, a closed verification receipt with independently downloaded manifest/ciphertext SHA-256 values, isolated decrypt/restore, restored database/object checksums and application verification. The live droplet volumes must be the source. Repeatable command: make offsite-droplet-restore (maps already-configured .merc-secrets.env R2_* keys; encrypts on the droplet; does not create paid resources). Isolated seed rehearsal: make offsite-independent-restore
expected_evidence.stripe: redacted test-mode fixture IDs covering success, decline, retry/idempotency, refund, dispute, Connect restriction, payout hold/manual release/failure, webhook replay/out-of-order, and reconciliation
expected_evidence.alert: redacted receiver delivery ID, delivery timestamp, acknowledgement, deduplication, and resolved notification
expected_evidence.canary: two approved synthetic buyers and two distinct operator-controlled Metal worker identities exercised within every configured bound, with both agent restarts proven by durable process-session transitions
expected_evidence.review: required approving review on the exact-head GO-closure PR from the named non-author collaborator
expected_evidence.governance: exact-candidate approval receipts from the named legal, privacy, tax, payments, security, trust-and-safety, licensing, and support authorities plus PASS receipts for both tabletops, DSAR deletion/export, backup tombstones, and asset/model provenance
